{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Aenima Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: After 10.000 Days, I would choose another Tool album for its heavy sound and intricate songs.

ItemID: NA; Title: Fallen; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melodic heaviness appeals to me, but it is a less immediate choice than more Tool.
ItemID: NA; Title: Year Zero; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am looking for guitar-driven metal right now rather than an electronic and industrial sound.
ItemID: NA; Title: The High End Of Low Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This is less connected to the melodic metal and progressive rock I have recently been exploring.
ItemID: NA; Title: Lateralus; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: I would choose this to explore more of Tool's complex rhythms and immersive heavy songs after 10.000 Days.
ItemID: NA; Title: The War Within; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: My interest in Advance And Vanquish and In Flames makes its aggressive riffs a strong choice today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Black Gives Way To Blue; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its dark, melodic hard rock sounds appealing, but I would leave it for another visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Hypnotize Explicit Lyrics; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The rhythmic intensity fits my interest in Ten Thousand Fists, though Tool and The War Within take priority today.
